question: Who led the Bharat Jodo Yatra 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rahul Gandhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****Bharat Jodo Yatra:**

__
 
• It is **a political campaign organized by the Indian National Congress (INC)** to unite the people of India and promote national integration.
 
• Senior Congress leader **Rahul Gandhi initiated the movement** by motivating the party cadre and the public to embark on a **4,080 km journey** from **Kanyakumari(Tamil Nadu) to** the union territory of **Jammu and Kashmir.**
 
• This journey **took almost 150 days to complete.**
 
• The march started from Kanyakumari on 7 September and ended on 30 January 2023.
 
 
• Rahul Gandhi unfurled the national tricolour at Lal Chowk in Srinagar bringing the padayatra to an end
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rahul Gandhi** is an Indian politician and **Member of Parliament** from INC representing **Wayanad, Kerala** in **Lok Sabha**.

 
 
• He previously represented the constituency of Amethi, Uttar Pradesh.
 
• He is the **chairperson** of the **Indian Youth Congress**, the **National Students Union of India** and a trustee of the Rajiv Gandhi Foundation and Rajiv Gandhi Charitable Trust.
 
• He was also the **president of INC from December 2017 to July 2019.**
 
 
 
• Sonia Gandhi is a former President of the Congress Party who served as its leader for over two decades, but she stepped down from the position in 2017 and is currently the Chairperson of the Congress Parliamentary Party.
 
 
• She is the** longest-serving president of the Indian National Congress.**
 
• She has been a **Member of Parliament in Lok Sabha from Rae Bareli constituency since 2004.**
 
 
 
• **Priyanka Gandhi** is a popular politician and the **general secretary of the All India Congress Committee in charge of Uttar Pradesh.**
 
 
• She is known for her charismatic personality and strong communication skills. She is the sister of Rahul Gandhi.
